coreCriteria.name: Compliance
coreCriteria.description: Are the requirements from the prompt covered in the produced artifact? 1 = covered, 0.5 = partial, 0 = missing.

coreCriteria.name: Works out of the box
coreCriteria.description: Does it run and behave as expected without manual fixes? 1 = OK, 0.5 = logic bugs, 0 = doesn't run.

coreCriteria.name: Look
coreCriteria.description: Visual quality. 2 = better than expected, 1.5 = good, 1 = OK, 0.5 = defects, 0 = broken.

coreCriteria.name: Code quality
coreCriteria.description: Subjective code quality. 1 = OK, 0.5 = could be better, 0 = mess / unfinished.

coreCriteria.name: Agent logic
coreCriteria.description: Does the model follow the agent workflow (check files, edit, verify, summarize)?

tasks.name: Snake game
tasks.description: Create a working Snake game in a single HTML file. The game must be playable in a browser with arrow key controls, score display, and game-over state.
tasks.systemPrompt: Write a snake game in javascript, css, html in one file. Build a classic Snake game on a 30x30 grid. The snake moves continuously in one of four directions and grows when eating food. If it hits a wall or itself, the game ends. Implement keyboard controls for player movement. Add a CPU-controlled snake mode that automatically searches for food. Add the three game modes: human vs human, cpu vs human, cpu vs cpu. Display the score during gameplay. Include a start menu and game over screen. Allow restarting the game with a keypress. Use file name "snake_{{MODEL_ID}}_01.html"

tasks.name: Todo App
tasks.description: Create a simple Todo app in a single HTML file with add/complete/delete functionality.
tasks.systemPrompt:
Build a Todo app in a single self-contained HTML file. Requirements:
- Add new todos
- Mark todos as complete (strikethrough)
- Delete todos
- Filter: All / Active / Completed
- Persist to localStorage

Deliver only the HTML file.

extraCriteria.name: Persistence
extraCriteria.description: Does the app correctly persist and restore todos from localStorage?
